reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin pack that provides 45 multi-role expert skill bundles, registers them for discovery, and includes tools for generating and coordinating skill-based agent workflows.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可安装和注册的多角色专家 Skill 套件，并支持生成及编排基于 Skill 的智能体工作流。
summaries.en: Provides installable multi-role expert skill bundles for DeepSeek Harness, with runtime registration and tools for generating and coordinating skill-based agent workflows.

capabilities: Registers multiple dsh skill bundles through a Cordis plugin
Installs or links skill files under ~/.dsh/skills
Generates new skill bundles from supplied prompts and SOP data
Provides skill instructions that may coordinate dsh subagents
